ns2:section.sectionText: This course is open to students pursuing the Graduate Minor in Information Technology. Mobile technology has become an integral part of our daily lives. We are able to communicate with others almost anywhere and at any time. The forms of electronic communication have diversified to include voice, text messages, email, pictures, video and data. The devices, such as smartphones, may include a camera, global positioning system (GPS), and accelerometer. Further, mobile devices may have computing power and features that rival early desktop computers. The objective of this course is to examine mobile technology ecosphere, understand its influence on individuals, groups, and organizations.
